transliteration.ar-Latn-x-alalc: Muhammad b. Husayn b. Muhammad, known as Ibn ʿAyn al-Mulk; he is also called al-Qāq, which is the raven in the language of the people of al-Shām.

tr: Muhammed b. Hüseyn b. Muhammed, İbn Ayn el-Melk olarak meşhur; ona Kâk da denilir ki bu Şam halkının dilinde kargadır.
ar: محمد بن حسين بن محمد، المعروف ب ابن عين الملك ، ويقال له القاق وهو الغراب في لغة أهل الشام
